messages:
maria: hitting intermittent 401s from Edge TS SDK on Vercel Edge Functions. Works in local Node but fails when deployed. Anyone seen this?
jia: can you share a minimal repro + SDK version? :eyes:
maria: steps to repro:
```
1) next 13.4 app using pages/api as edge function
2) client calls /api/proxy which uses @redwood/edge-sdk v0.8.3
3) client includes Authorization header and cookies
4) deploy to Vercel -> random requests return 401
```
maria: locally every request returns 200. on Vercel the request logs show Authorization present in the browser request but the upstream sees no auth or cookie in some responses (preflight passes).
omar: which Vercel runtime exactly? edge runtime or node?
maria: Vercel Edge runtime (edge functions). Next config sets experimental: { runtime: 'experimental-edge' }

sam: we had a similar "header reorder" regression last quarter with an older fetch polyfill. Which fetch/shim are you bundling?
maria: not bundling anything explicitly, using the runtime fetch in the edge function. SDK import is: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/edge-sdk'`
jia: can you paste the raw headers you see in the edge function console (console.log([...req.headers]))? need exact ordering & key casings.
maria: pasted logs -> snippet:```
[
  [ 'host', 'my-app.vercel.app' ],
  [ 'sec-fetch-site', 'same-origin' ],
  [ 'authorization', 'Bearer xxxx' ],
  [ 'cookie', 'session=abcd' ]
]
```
maria: and in failing cases:```
[
  [ 'host', 'my-app.vercel.app' ],
  [ 'authorization', 'Bearer xxxx' ],
  [ 'sec-fetch-site', 'same-origin' ],
  [ 'cookie', 'session=abcd' ]
]
```
maria: notice authorization comes before sec-fetch-site sometimes; our edge proxy strips auth unless sec-fetch-site is last (we discovered).
omar: interesting — sounds like a header ordering edge-case where Vercel's proxy + upstream middleware mis-evaluates header precedence. we've seen this in CF workers too but usually different ordering. two quick repro tries: 1) try client-side fetch with `credentials: 'include'` to force browser to keep cookie semantics, 2) add a custom header that our SDK will forward as `x-rw-forward-authorization` and have the backend accept that (temporary).
sam: also try upgrading the SDK — we pushed a patch to normalize header casing/ordering in v0.10.1 (canary) which helps some of these runtime combos.
maria: upgraded to 0.10.1 canary and retested: still flaky but failure rate dropped ~80%.
jia: can you try this minimal client snippet and tell us if it stabilizes?
```js
// client
fetch('/api/proxy', {
  method: 'POST',
  credentials: 'include',
  headers: {
    'x-rw-forward-authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ q: 'test' })
})
```
maria: adding credentials: 'include' + custom header -> 200/200 for several minutes of load test. looks stable in that config. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: created ticket T-4523 (support-4523) for this thread and assigned to eng-runtime.
omar: long-term we should normalize headers inside the SDK before doing any fetch so ordering/casing won't matter (ENG-876 filed). also need a compatibility note for Vercel Edge in docs.

deploy-bot: rolled runtime patch r-runtime-2025-11-02 to canary infra that includes header-ordering mitigation. :rocket:
jia: leaving this open until eng-runtime confirms full fix and we ship a non-canary SDK release. filing follow-up PR to add automated repro in our e2e matrix.
maria: thanks all — workaround and canary patch fixed our production issue for now. will report if anything else pops up. :relieved:
